title: pcapng: use block-informaton table entries for standard block types.
description:
Rename "block_type_handler" to "block_type_information", as a
pcapng_block_type_handler_t structure has more than just routines to
handle the block type.

Replace several switches on the block type with a lookup in the table of
pcapng_block_type_information_t's.  (SHBs still require special handling
for various reasons, such as an SHB *specifying* the byte order for a
*new* section rather than being *in* the byte order of the SHB that
began the *current* section.)

Make pcapng_write_sysdig_event_block() static, as it's now called
through pointers in the pcapng_block_type_handler_t structure. Get rid
of wiretap/pcapng-sysdig-int.h, as its only purpose was to declare
pcapng_write_sysdig_event_block() so that it could be called directly
from pcapng.c.

Disallow registering a pcapng block type if it's already registered.

Get rid of the BT_INDEX_ values; they require manual maintenance.
Instead, have a pointer to the table of options for a block type in the
pcapng_block_type_information_t structure.  Have a separate API to
allocate option tables, so that multiple
pcapng_block_type_information_t's can hare a pointer, e.g. EPBs and PBs
have the same options.

Use the "internal" field of a pcapng_block_type_information_t to set the
"internal" flag for a block.

Sort the function pointers in a pcapng_block_type_information_t
structure; the reader and processor functions are both used when reading
packets, so keep them together.
